hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.cs) (cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && dotnet format "HarnessDemo.slnx" --include "$f" --no-restore) ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *appsettings.Production.json*|*/.github/workflows/*) echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"Blocked: production settings and CI workflow files require explicit approval"}}' ;; esac; }
